title: Knowledge Engineer
jobDescription:
Project Role : Knowledge Engineer


Project Role Description : Design and structure knowledge frameworks that enable AI systems to reason and make informed decisions. Capture and translate expert and unstructured knowledge into ontologies, knowledge graphs, and semantic models, ensuring accuracy and context for automation and insights. Apply advanced analytics on knowledge graphs to drive problem-solving and actionable insights.


Must have skills : Microsoft Azure Data Services


Good to have skills : NA
Minimum
18 year(s) of experience is required


Educational Qualification : 15 years full time education


Summary:

AI Powered Tech Talent

As a Knowledge Engineer, a typical day involves designing and structuring comprehensive knowledge frameworks that empower artificial intelligence systems to reason effectively and make well-informed decisions. This role requires capturing expert knowledge and transforming unstructured information into organized ontologies, knowledge graphs, and semantic models. Throughout the day, the Knowledge Engineer ensures that these knowledge representations maintain accuracy and contextual relevance, supporting automation processes and generating valuable insights. Additionally, the role includes applying advanced analytical techniques to knowledge graphs to facilitate problem-solving and deliver actionable intelligence across various domains.

Roles Responsibilities:
  • Expected to be a SME with deep knowledge and experience.
  • Should have influencing and Advisory skills.
  • Engage with multiple teams and responsible for team decisions.
  • Expected to provide solutions to problems that apply across multiple teams, and provide solutions to business area problems.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to align knowledge frameworks with organizational goals and evolving business needs.
  • Lead initiatives to enhance knowledge management practices and promote best practices across teams.
  • Mentor junior team members to foster skill development and knowledge sharing within the team.

    Professional Technical Skills:


    Must To Have Skills:
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Azure Data Services.
  • Experience with cloud-based data storage, processing, and analytics solutions.
  • Strong understanding of knowledge representation techniques including ontologies and semantic modeling.
  • Ability to work with large-scale knowledge graphs and apply advanced analytics for insight generation.
  • Familiarity with data integration and transformation processes within cloud environments.
  • Skilled in collaborating with cross-functional teams to implement scalable knowledge solutions.
  • The candidate should have minimum 18 years of experience in Microsoft Azure Data Services.
  • This position is based at our Bengaluru office.
  • A 15 years full time education is required.


    Qualification 15 years full time education

title: Large Language Model Architect
jobDescription:
Project Role : Large Language Model Architect


Project Role Description : Architect large language models (LLM) that can process and generate natural language. Design neural network parameters, trained on large quantities of unlabeled text data.


Must have skills : Google Cloud Data Services


Good to have skills : Snowflake Data Warehouse, Microsoft Azure Data Services
Minimum
18 year(s) of experience is required


Educational Qualification : 15 years full time education


Summary:

AI Powered Tech Talent

As a senior AI/ML Computational Scientist, you will design, build, and operationalize artificial intelligence and machine learning solutions for enterprise clients, combining custom models with cloud and third-party AI services to deliver production-ready outcomes. Your role spans the full solution lifecycle assessing client needs and data, selecting and customizing models (including Deep Learning, Generative AI, and Large Language Models), designing scalable data and MLOps/LLMOps pipelines for training and production, and ensuring quality, value, and reliability of deployed systems.
Formulate real-world problems into practical, efficient, and scalable AI and Machine Learning solutions
Develop and implement machine learning algorithms, models, and computational systems design and build scalable data pipelines to support model training and production with DevOps MLOps
Customize and apply Deep Learning and Gen AI models for various use cases based on the business needs, data availability, system and infrastructure requirements - including edge device and HPC
Engage in research and development of new AI and high-performance compute algorithms, models, and simulations along with their applications to solve complex business problems at client sites
Work with large-scale datasets and utilize data preprocessing techniques to ensure high-quality input for training and production
Implement and maintain efficient data storage and retrieval mechanisms for models and knowledge using appropriate tools
Justify the value of model approaches in business problems
Collaborate with teams from both business and technical sides, including users, use case representatives, business owners, engineers, architects, and UI designers, to achieve end-to-end project goals and integrate into production
Bachelor''s Degree or equivalent
Minimum of 7 years of experience as a machine learning engineer or scientist, deploying models in production at scale , including monitoring, alerting, automatic bug filing and auditing.
Minimum of 7 years of experience in applying theoretical foundations of computer science, including computer system architecture, system engineering, and programming
Minimum of 5 years of experience in distributed computing systems and architecture that may include big data, high-performance compute, engineering simulations, scientific compute, grid and cloud computing, distributed networks
Minimum of 4 years of experience in building and deploying AI/ML based software to a cloud environment.
Proficiency in Python and python-based AI/ML framework and familiarity with relevant libraries and frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch)..
Experience working with language models like LLM''s APIs and optimizing their usage for specific applications.
Experience with the following programming languages: Python, C++, Java, R, SQL
Strong written verbal communication skills and ability to communicate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders
Strong client-facing skillsets in a consulting environment
Strong cross-functional skills with the ability to collaborate with a variety of internal and client-side teams
Entrepreneurial mindset with a curiosity and passion for emergent tech and driving innovation
MS or PhD in related field preferred (computer science, engineering, etc.)
As a Large Language Model Architect, a typical day involves designing and structuring advanced language models capable of understanding and generating human-like text. This role requires careful planning of neural network configurations and managing extensive datasets to ensure the models perform effectively. Collaboration with various teams to align architectural decisions with project goals and continuous refinement of model parameters to enhance natural language processing capabilities are key aspects of the daily workflow.

Roles Responsibilities:
  • Expected to be a SME with deep knowledge and experience.
  • Should have influencing and Advisory skills.
  • Engage with multiple teams and responsible for team decisions.
  • Expected to provide solutions to problems that apply across multiple teams, and provide solutions to business area problems.
  • Lead the development and implementation of scalable language model architectures that meet organizational needs.
  • Facilitate knowledge sharing and mentorship within the team to foster professional growth and innovation.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical solutions that leverage large language models.

    Professional Technical Skills:


    Must To Have Skills:
  • Proficiency in Google Cloud Data Services.
  • Good To Have Skills: Experience with Snowflake Data Warehouse, Microsoft Azure Data Services.
  • Strong expertise in designing and optimizing neural network architectures for natural language processing.
  • Experience in managing and processing large-scale unlabeled text datasets for model training.
  • Ability to integrate cloud-based data services to support model deployment and scalability.
  • Familiarity with data pipeline development and orchestration in cloud environments.
  • The candidate should have minimum 18 years of experience in Google Cloud Data Services.
  • This position is based at our Bengaluru office.
  • A 15 years full time education is required.

Role Summary
We are seeking a Senior Manager to serve as the strategic bridge between Profit business stakeholders, enterprise data teams, and AI product teams. This individual will act as the Enterprise Data Partner for Profit, translating complex business concepts, profitability metrics, processes, and KPIs into scalable enterprise data models that enable analytics, reporting, automation, and AI-driven solutions.
The role requires deep expertise in profitability, business performance, enterprise data modelling, and data governance, combined with the ability to work across technology and business teams. The successful candidate will help establish trusted enterprise data foundations that can be consumed by reporting tools, digital products, and AI agents.

Key Responsibilities
Enterprise Data Strategy Modelling
  • Partner with business leaders to define and evolve enterprise data models supporting profitability and business performance management.
  • Translate business processes, metrics, rules, and calculations into reusable enterprise data assets.
  • Define business data requirements, semantic layers, taxonomies, and data relationships across multiple systems.
  • Ensure data consistency, quality, governance, and alignment with enterprise architecture standards.
  • Serve as the primary liaison between business stakeholders and enterprise data engineering teams.
Profit Domain Expertise
  • Act as the Profit Subject Matter Expert, providing deep understanding of profitability drivers, operational metrics, and business performance indicators.
  • Define and standardize key profit-related metrics, business rules, and reporting definitions.
  • Partner with Finance, Operations, and Leadership teams to ensure enterprise-wide consistency in profitability measurement.
  • Drive initiatives that improve decision-making through trusted data and actionable insights.
AI Agent Enablement
  • Design enterprise data foundations that can be consumed by AI agents and intelligent automation solutions.
  • Work with product and AI teams to identify opportunities where structured enterprise data can improve AI agent accuracy, reasoning, and decision support.
  • Define business context, metadata, and knowledge frameworks that enable agentic AI use cases.
  • Support development of AI-powered solutions focused on profit insights, performance management, and operational effectiveness.
Product Program Leadership
  • Lead strategic initiatives focused on enterprise data modernization.
  • Partner with technology teams to prioritize and deliver data products and business capabilities.
  • Manage stakeholder alignment, governance, roadmaps, risks, and value realization.
  • Drive adoption of enterprise data assets across business functions.

Core Skills: Enterprise Data Modelling, Data Strategy, Data Governance, Profitability Management, Business Performance Management, Analytics, Stakeholder Management
Nice to Have: Agentic AI, Data Products, Generative AI, Knowledge Management
Experience Requirements
  • 1518+ years of experience in Enterprise Data, Business Performance Management, Profitability Analysis, or Data Strategy.

  • Deep knowledge of profitability drivers, financial performance management, and operational business metrics.

Introduction
Welcome to Gallagher in India where expertise, technology, and purpose come together. Since 2006, Gallagher in India has supported global teams by delivering quality, service, and speed through deep expertise, smart technology, and specialized knowledge services. More than just an operations center, its a place where careers grow through collaboration, continuous learning, and purposeful work. We drive efficiency, compliance, and innovation so our teams can focus on serving clients. If you enjoy solving problems and working with purpose, Gallagher is the place where you can grow and feel a sense of belonging.


How you'll make an impact
Senior Program Manager Intelligent Automation & AI

Location: Any of the Gallagher India office
Department: IT GCOE
Reports To: AVP- Applications Development

Introduction

At Gallagher, we are committed to helping our clients, colleagues, and communities thrive through innovation, integrity, and excellence. We are seeking an experienced Senior Program Manager Intelligent Automation & AI to lead strategic transformation initiatives across our global operations.

This role is responsible for the successful delivery of enterprise-wide automation and AI programs, leveraging technologies such as Robotic Process Automation (RPA), Process Mining, Task Mining, Intelligent Document Processing (IDP), Workflow Automation, Artificial Intelligence/Machine Learning (AI/ML), Conversational AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), Generative AI, and Business Intelligence & Analytics solutions.

The ideal candidate will bring extensive experience in the BFSI sector, preferably within Insurance, coupled with strong program management capabilities, stakeholder engagement expertise, vendor management experience, and a proven track record of delivering measurable business outcomes through technology-enabled transformation.

How You'll Make an Impact

As a Senior Program Manager, you will:

  • Lead and govern complex intelligent automation and AI transformation programs from ideation through implementation and value realization.
  • Partner with business leaders, operational teams, Process Excellence functions, Risk and Compliance teams, and technology stakeholders to identify, prioritize, and execute automation opportunities.
  • Develop and manage program roadmaps, delivery plans, budgets, resource allocations, and benefits realization frameworks.
  • Drive adoption of automation and AI solutions that improve operational efficiency, quality, customer experience, productivity, and scalability.
  • Ensure alignment of automation initiatives with organizational strategy, governance requirements, security standards, and regulatory obligations.
  • Establish effective program governance, reporting structures, and executive stakeholder communications.
  • Lead global cross-functional teams operating in Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid delivery models.
  • Monitor program progress, dependencies, risks, and issues, implementing mitigation strategies to ensure successful delivery.
  • Track and report key performance indicators including efficiency gains, cost savings, error reduction, productivity improvements, and business value realization.
  • Facilitate collaboration among business, technology, operations, and vendor partners to achieve program objectives.
  • Drive continuous improvement and innovation through the adoption of emerging automation and AI technologies.
  • Provide thought leadership on intelligent automation and enterprise AI capabilities across the organization.


Key Responsibilities
Program Leadership & Delivery
  • Lead enterprise-scale automation and AI programs from initiation through closure.
  • Define program scope, objectives, deliverables, success criteria, timelines, and governance frameworks.
  • Develop comprehensive project plans, schedules, budgets, and resource strategies.
  • Ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope, and within approved budgets.
  • Manage multiple concurrent projects and interdependent workstreams.
Stakeholder Management
  • Collaborate with senior business leaders to align initiatives with strategic priorities.
  • Build strong relationships across business functions, technology teams, and operational stakeholders.
  • Communicate program status, risks, dependencies, and outcomes to executive leadership and governance committees.
  • Manage stakeholder expectations and facilitate effective decision-making.
Automation & AI Enablement
  • Identify opportunities to implement:
    • Robotic Process Automation (RPA)
    • Process Mining and Task Mining
    • Intelligent Document Processing (IDP)
    • Workflow Automation
    • Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning
    • Conversational AI
    • Large Language Models (LLMs)
    • Generative AI Solutions
    • BI and Analytics Platforms
  • Evaluate business cases and ensure initiatives deliver measurable value.
Risk, Compliance & Governance
  • Ensure adherence to organizational governance frameworks, information security standards, and regulatory requirements.
  • Identify, assess, and mitigate program risks and issues.
  • Support audit, risk, and compliance reviews as required.
  • Maintain program documentation and governance records.
Vendor & Partner Management
  • Manage strategic vendor relationships and third-party delivery partners.
  • Support contract negotiations, performance reviews, service management, and issue resolution.
  • Monitor vendor performance against agreed service levels and contractual obligations.
  • Ensure vendor solutions align with business objectives, security requirements, and compliance standards.
Team Leadership
  • Lead and mentor project managers, business analysts, automation specialists, and cross-functional teams.
  • Foster a collaborative, inclusive, and high-performance culture.
  • Promote best practices in program management, automation delivery, and organizational change management.


Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
  • 18+ years of overall professional experience, including significant experience within the BFSI sector.
  • Minimum 8-10 years of Program Management experience leading enterprise-scale transformation initiatives.
  • Demonstrated experience delivering intelligent automation, digital transformation, or AI-driven programs.
  • Strong understanding of insurance operations, business processes, and industry regulations.
  • Experience managing geographically distributed teams and global stakeholders.


Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience within the Insurance industry strongly preferred.
  • Project Management Professional (PMP) certification.
  • Agile certifications such as Scrum Master, SAFe, Agile Practitioner, or equivalent.
  • Microsoft Power Platform certifications.
  • Experience with Microsoft Power Automate and broader Microsoft automation ecosystem.
  • Exposure to cloud-based automation and AI platforms.


Technical Skills
  • Robotic Process Automation (UiPath, Automation Anywhere, Blue Prism, or similar)
  • Process Mining and Task Mining platforms
  • Intelligent Document Processing solutions
  • Workflow and Process Orchestration tools
  • AI/ML and Generative AI technologies
  • Conversational AI platforms
  • Microsoft Power Platform and Power Automate
  • Business Intelligence and Analytics solutions
  • Planview, Jira, Azure DevOps (ADO), or similar project management tools


Competencies
  • Strategic Thinking
  • Executive Communication
  • Program & Portfolio Management
  • Leadership and Team Development
  • Stakeholder Management
  • Risk Management
  • Vendor Management
  • Business Acumen
  • Decision-Making and Problem Solving
  • Influence and Negotiation
  • Results Orientation
  • Collaboration and Relationship Building


What We Value

At Gallagher, we value individuals who demonstrate:

  • Integrity and ethical decision-making
  • Customer and business focus
  • Innovation and continuous improvement
  • Accountability and ownership
  • Inclusive leadership and collaboration
  • Commitment to quality and excellence

Experience Level: Senior Leadership
Employment Type: Full-Time
Travel Requirement: As required for business needs (domestic and international)



About you

Qualifications:

  • University Degree and minimum 5 years prior relevant experience, or equivalent experience.

Preferred:

  • App development/programming
  • Database design
  • System architecture & integration
  • Communication and stakeholder management skills
  • Root cause analysis
  • Product development management
  • Product portfolio management.


Compensation and benefits

At Gallagher, we believe supporting our colleagues goes far beyond the role itself. For more information, .

  • Competitive compensation
  • Comprehensive benefits programs designed to support your well-being
  • Career development opportunities and ongoing learning
  • A collaborative, people-first culture with accessible leadership
  • The opportunity to do meaningful work with global reach and local impact
